conference_profiles.Eurosonic Noorderslag: A frost-lit January compass for the year ahead — heavy on tastemaker discovery, northern European coalitions, and the first handshake energy of showcase season.
conference_profiles.Reeperbahn Festival: Hamburg scale: corporates, publishers, and nightlife infrastructure in the same breath; digital and sync money never far from the bar conversation.
conference_profiles.Tallinn Music Week: Compact city, outsized Baltic-digital ambition — programme text leans civic innovation and cross-border independence as much as repertoire.
conference_profiles.MaMA Convention: Parisian density: rights, narrative, and ‘cultural exception’ thinking threaded through a Francophone-leaning speaker bench.
conference_profiles.BIME: Atlantic-facing trade floor — Ibero-American corridor and LATAM bridges show up in titles as often as northern European export talk.
conference_profiles.Linecheck: Milanese design sensibility meets supply-chain realism: production, manufacturing metaphors, and EU policy as craft.
conference_profiles.The Great Escape: Brighton’s industry holiday with a UK-export spine — balancing domestic ecosystem angst with international opportunity.
conference_profiles.WOMEX: Visa math, showcase diplomacy, and world-music export literacy — the most explicitly geopolitical grammar of the set.

frequent_speakers: Illustrative only in preview data — run the pipeline on real programmes to populate cross-event repeats.
key_findings: The printed conversation clusters around monetization, mobility, and discovery — governance and labor stay in the footnotes unless a crisis headline forces them center.
‘Export’ is the default success narrative; domestic audience sustainability appears as decoration rather than infrastructure.
Sustainability shows up as commitments and panels far more often than as operational metrics tied to routing or budgeting.
AI appears in bursts tied to hype cycles — rarely as a grounded ops track spanning legal, ethics, and workflow.
Geographic diversity on marquees is often framed as market access rather than aesthetic or community reciprocity.
Secondary markets and transparent fan economics remain structurally under-addressed relative to their revenue share impact.
